events.verdict: DeRozan (SAC) is late to the spot and initiates contact to McCollum's (NOP) body that affects his SQBR.
Green (NOP) and DeRozan (SAC) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Sabonis (SAC) briefly grasps Matkovic's (NOP) arm off ball and immediately removes it.
Alvarado (NOP) initially absorbs the contact with DeRozan (SAC) and when he reaches in, he avoids making any illegal contact with DeRozan during his shooting motion.
McCollum (NOP) is not considered to be in the frontcourt when he initially deflects the ball, which he legally recovers and then starts his dribble.
LaVine (SAC) reaches in and grazes McCollum's (NOP) side and the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Green (NOP) avoids making any illegal contact with DeRozan's (SAC) arm during the jump shot attempt.
LaVine (SAC) contests McCollum's (NOP) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Alvarado (NOP) reaches in and grazes DeRozan (SAC) and the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Matkovic (NOP) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during DeRozan's (SAC) driving shot attempt.
Murray (SAC) commits a take foul on Murphy III (NOP).
Brown (NOP) commits a take foul on Monk (SAC).
DeRozan (SAC) commits a take foul on Robinson-Earl (NOP).
Brown (NOP) commits a take foul on Sabonis (SAC).
Brown (NOP) makes illegal contact to Monk's (SAC) arm as he attempts to pass.
Ellis (SAC) places a hand against McCollum's (NOP) side as he retreats away and he removes it as he enters his shooting motion.
Murray (SAC) legally contests McCollum's (NOP) jump shot attempt.
Green (NOP) legally contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Sabonis (SAC) attempts to establish himself in a screening position in Murphy III's (NOP) path and the contact that occurs as Murphy III moves around the pick is marginal.
Matkovic (NOP) briefly has an arm around Sabonis (SAC) as they engage during the rebound, which he immediately removes.
Monk (SAC) briefly has a grasp of Alvarado's (NOP) arm on the perimeter, but the contact is marginal.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Alvarado's (NOP) pass goes out of bounds.
Green (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball to steal it away from LaVine (SAC).
LaVine (SAC) briefly places both hands on Alvarado's (NOP) body during the drive, but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
DeRozan (SAC) legally contests Green's (NOP) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Monk (SAC) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during McCollum's (NOP) driving shot attempt.
